findings.detail: The extracted sum includes a separately presented subsidiary portfolio with fair value $294.975 million in addition to the consolidated portfolio total.

rationale: Raw source shows the consolidated schedule total fair value is $6.342711 billion (table 26 row 37), while extracted positions total $6.637686 billion. The $294.975 million excess exactly equals the separately presented subsidiary Total Portfolio Investments at table 79 row 54, proving a nested-schedule double count rather than a bad filing anchor.
